name: Veronica's Kitchen
notes: 4 photos: a laminated cover page with Daily Specials, a whiteboard listing breakfast/tacos/specials with no prices (its Tacos/Burritos/Chile Relleno/Torta items duplicate the priced printed menu, so the priced versions were kept and the unpriced whiteboard duplicates skipped), and two full printed menu pages (combination plates/tostadas/quesadillas/enchiladas/tortas/tacos, and breakfast/omelettes/burritos/soups/sandwiches/salads/burgers) which supplied most dishes.
